drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.sub: Prepare a complaint, an RTI application or a grievance draft. Nothing is sent anywhere. You review every field, then download a PDF.

forms.title: Official form
forms.sub: Fill the official Delhi income certificate application with your details. We only write on page 1, in English letters and digits. You complete the rest and sign it yourself.

forms.aadhaar: Your Aadhaar number is written on the PDF only. We never save it, and this screen shows only the last 4 digits.
forms.reviewHelp: These values will be written on the form. Fix anything that is wrong, then tick the box.
forms.notice: Sahaay is an AI assistant, not an official channel. This is the official form with your details written on it. Check it against the official source, attach the documents it asks for, and sign it yourself.

forms.err_changed: You changed something after reviewing. Please review again.
forms.err_failed: Could not prepare the form. Please try again.

case.title: My case
case.sub: Track your own progress on one service. You mark each step yourself.
case.own: Your own progress, not government status
case.n1: Check what you qualify for in the chat, then mark this step.
case.n2: Add your documents and see what is missing, then mark this step.
case.n3: Prepare your form, check every field, then mark this step.
case.n4: Submit on the official portal or office. Enter the date you submitted, then mark this step.
case.n5: Enter the reference number you received. We keep only the last 4 characters.
case.n6: All five steps are recorded. Keep your reference number safe.
case.readyCaption: Based on your checklist. Not a prediction of approval.
case.error: Could not load. Please try again.
case.saveError: Could not save. Please try again.
case.tooShort: Please enter at least 4 letters or digits.
case.futureDate: The date cannot be in the future.

privacy.title: Privacy and my data
privacy.sub: What Sahaay keeps about you, what it never keeps, and how to delete everything.
privacy.keep1: Details you chose to save, such as age or category, after you agreed.
privacy.keep2: Your case: the service, the steps you marked, your submission date, and a reference number cut to its last 4 characters.
privacy.keep3: Documents you confirmed: only the checked fields, with identity numbers cut to the last 4 digits.
privacy.never1: The photos or PDFs you upload. They are read in memory and discarded.
privacy.never2: Full Aadhaar, PAN, phone or bank numbers.
privacy.never3: PDFs we make for you. They go to you and are not stored.
privacy.modelNote: The AI model only sees text with identity numbers already hidden. Free-tier model providers may use what they receive, so never type real identity numbers into the chat.
privacy.deleteHelp: This removes your saved details, cases, documents, steps and submission details. It cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteConfirm: I understand this cannot be undone
privacy.deleted: All your saved data was deleted.
privacy.error: Could not load. Please try again.
privacy.deleteError: Could not delete. Please try again.
privacy.reports: Official sources and the date they were checked are shown with each answer. If something looks wrong, use “Report incorrect information” on a service card.
